    StartersKeyser Soze Turkish lamb pideThe Turkish crime lord nobody has seen. Spiced lamb, sumac onion, yoghurt.How to make it500g lamb mince1 brown onion, finely diced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp sweet paprika1 tbsp tomato paste1 tsp chilli flakes500g pizza dough1 egg, beaten1/2 red onion, thinly sliced1 tsp sumac200g Greek yoghurt1 handful flat-leaf parsleyBrown the lamb with the onion, half the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli, then stir in the tomato paste and cook until thick.Split the dough into 4 and roll each into a long oval.Spoon the lamb down the middle, fold the sides in and pinch the ends into boat shapes, then brush the edges with egg.Bake at 230°C until the crust is golden and crisp.Toss the red onion with the sumac, stir the rest of the garlic through the yoghurt, and top the pide with both and the parsley.Emerald beef empanadasThe Argentinians had no cocaine. Golden hand-crimped beef pastries.How to make it400g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced1 red capsicum, finely diced2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped60g green olives, chopped4 sheets of frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed1 egg, beaten1 cup flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped2 tbsp fresh oregano leaves, chopped2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp red wine vinegar125ml olive oilBrown the beef with the onion and capsicum, add the paprika and cumin and cook until dry, then cool and fold in the egg and olives.Cut 12cm rounds from the pastry, fill each with a spoonful, fold over and crimp the edges.Brush with egg and bake at 200°C until deep golden.Stir the parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar and oil with a pinch of salt and chilli to make the chimichurri, and serve it alongside.Lineup salted nuts, five to a bowlStep forward when your number is called.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsHungarian beef goulashA burned Hungarian saw the devil's face. Paprika beef, egg noodles, sour cream.How to make it1kg beef chuck, cut in 4cm pieces2 tbsp vegetable oil2 brown onions, sliced3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp sweet Hungarian paprika1 tsp caraway seeds2 tbsp tomato paste1 red capsicum, sliced750ml beef stock375g wide egg noodles30g butter150g sour creamBrown the beef in batches in the oil and set aside.Cook the onions slowly in the same pot until soft and golden, then add the garlic, paprika, caraway and tomato paste for a minute.Return the beef with the capsicum and stock, cover and simmer gently until the beef is very tender.Boil the noodles, drain and toss with the butter.Serve the goulash over the noodles with a spoon of sour cream.Skokie deep-dish sausage pizzaVerbal's Skokie barbershop quartet. Italian sausage, four cheeses and chunky tomato.How to make it500g pizza dough2 tbsp olive oil400g Italian pork sausages, skins removed250g mozzarella, sliced100g provolone, sliced50g parmesan, grated100g ricotta800g tinned crushed tomatoes2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp dried oregano1 tsp fennel seedsSimmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt until thick.Oil a deep 25cm cake tin and press the dough over the base and 4cm up the sides.Layer the mozzarella and provolone over the base, then crumble over the sausage with the fennel seeds and dot with ricotta.Spoon the tomato sauce over the top, scatter with parmesan and bake at 220°C until the crust is deep golden.Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into thick wedges.SweetsGold lighter creme bruleeVerbal lights up with his gold lighter. Vanilla bean custard under torched sugar.How to make it500ml pouring cream1 vanilla bean, split5 egg yolks90g caster sugar, plus 4 tbsp for the topsWarm the cream with the vanilla bean until steaming, then take it off the heat.Whisk the yolks and 90g sugar until pale, then whisk in the warm cream and strain.Pour into 4 ramekins, set them in a roasting tin of hot water and bake at 150°C until just set with a wobble.Chill well, then sprinkle each with sugar and torch until dark golden.DrinksKobayashi Porcelain espresso martiniRead the bottom of the coffee cup. Fresh espresso, vodka and coffee liqueur.How to make it200ml fresh espresso, cooled160ml vodka80ml coffee liqueur2 tsp sugar syrup12 coffee beans2 cups ice cubesShake the espresso, vodka, liqueur and syrup hard with ice in two batches.Strain into 4 chilled glasses and float 3 coffee beans on each.Station coffee, blackThis is shit, but hey, I'm in a police station.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
